crossRefs.note: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
“If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
“So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

“ ‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days.…
On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of…
“ ‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.
translations.bsb: Then David sent messengers to get her, and when she came to him, he slept with her. (Now she had just purified herself from her uncleanness.) Then she returned home.
translations.kjv: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.
translations.asv: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned unto her house.
